events.title: Man of La Mancha
events.description:
The Two Of Us Productions, the award-winning theater company based in Copake NY, is pleased to present Man Of La Mancha, the beloved Broadway classic musical being presented with a live 16-piece orchestra!  Man Of La Mancha runs for 2 weekends only, Nov. 6h, 7th and 8th, and the following weekend of Nov. 13th, 14th, and 15th, 2026.  You don’t want to miss this heartbreaking and inspirational Tony Award-winning musical, based on Cervantes’ Don Quixote, about one man’s refusal to give up his impossible dream

Man of La Mancha is one of the world’s most popular musicals. Inspired by Miguel de Cervantes’ 17th-century masterwork Don Quixote and set during the Spanish Inquisition, the original 1965 production won five Tony Awards, including Best Musical. Cervantes is in prison awaiting trial during the Spanish Inquisition. He and his fellow prisoners perform a play-within-a-play, telling the story of the elderly Alonso Quijana, who renames himself “Don Quixote” and goes on a quest to right all wrongs in the world. The rousing, Spanish-inflected score includes the classic numbers “The Impossible Dream,” “I, Don Quixote,” “Dulcinea,” “I Really Like Him” and “Little Bird.”

Man Of La Mancha features Mark Leinung in the title role of Don Quixote, Keith Allerton as his manservant Sancho, Connie Lopez as Aldonza, Mason Lowe as the Inn Keeper, Karissa Payson as Antonia, Cyndi Miller as the Housekeeper, Zach Nayer as the Padre, Zach Wobensmith as Dr. Carrasco, Matt Leinung as Pedro and the Barber, Brandon Macey as Anselmo, Diane Barkstrom as the Gypsy Dancer, Fran Martino as a Muleteer and Knight Attendant, and John Peterson as the Captain.

Man Of La Mancha is playing for 2 weekends only, November 6th, 7th & 8th, and the following weekend of November 13th, 14th & 15th, 2026.  Friday and Saturday performances are at 7:30pm and Sunday matinees are at 3pm.  The comfortable & accessible Theater at the Copake Grange is located at the Copake Grange Hall located at 628 Empire Road in Copake NY, right around the corner from the clocktower in the center of town.  Tickets are $20 for adults, $15 for Students & Seniors.  Please call for Group Rates.  For advance reservations visit www.TheTwoOfUsProductions.org or call 518-771-1003.  Make your reservations early for the best seats on the date you want!

The Two Of Us Productions is well known throughout the Hudson Valley for presenting quality theater, both musicals and dramas.  Their recent productions of Cabaret, The Minutes, Ms. Holmes & Ms. Watson, Pippin, Blithe Spirit, The Lady And The Clarinet, Sweeney Todd, A Shayna Maidel, Chicago, Nunsense, Les Miserables, next to normal, Deathtrap, and Jesus Christ Superstar were all recognized by the Theatre Association of NYS with multiple theatrical quality awards.

events.title: Sleep: North America 2026
events.description:
Today, the legendary band Sleep releases new single “Have Spacesuit Will Travel” via Third Man Records, their first new music since 2018. In addition, the band announces a fall North American tour, as well as releases the first issue of the Sleep Comic Book, written by bassist and songwriter Al Cisneros.
“Have Spacesuit Will Travel” begins Sleep’s first mission without Matt Pike on guitar. The music and art are alive and after the decades of obstacles that Sleep has overcome, it is time to move forward and make songs and albums. Al wishes Matt the best on his earth bound maneuvers.
Alongside Cisneros, the latest incarnation of Sleep features Dale Crover on drums and Bubba Dupree on guitar. Dale has been in some serious bands, like the Melvins and Redd Kross. That Al would seek him out makes sense, an almost elementary choice that probably wouldn’t raise too many eyebrows. Bubba Dupree, from the fiercely loved band Void, hailing out of Columbia, MD, is a pick that is not only completely mind-blowing, but a choice no one would have seen coming. Just the thought of Bubba, who was amazing from the first Void shows on, playing guitar in Sleep is almost too much for the mind to comprehend.
Al Cisneros, Bubba Dupree, and Dale Crover as a trio looks really good on paper, but the only way to see if it worked was to get everyone in a room and play. Al says the answer made itself evident immediately: “The vibe of the first jam was obvious. It was blue sunglasses-era Iommi in the quality, and equally awesome is Bubba is also one of the coolest people I’ve been able to make music with.”
“Have Spacesuit Will Travel” at no time tries to pick up where The Sciences left off. There’s a considerable amount of new blood in the band, so imitation, as Bubba notes, would greatly limit the potential of three very unique and talented musicians. That being said, Sleep answers to an incredible recorded history, literally decades in the making, so it would not be surprising that Al, Dale and Bubba would find themselves composing in the spirit of that which had been established so long ago. The three of them were able to make an album that can truly be identified as genuine Sleep music, yet with a sharpness and agility to the recordings.

events.title: LIVE: The Horsenecks
events.description: The Horsenecks are Gabrielle Macrae and Barry Southern. Based in Astoria, Oregon, they are two multi-instrumentalists who have come together from traditional music backgrounds and found a sound that weaves through layers of influence that include early Appalachian stringband music, classic country, bluegrass and original folk. Gabrielle’s fiddle style is the result of being raised in the Old Time music hotbed of Portland, OR and being exposed to the fiddle traditions of the Southeast US through years of traveling to festivals and learning from some of the greatest players in the genre. She gained notoriety as a clawhammer banjo player through her work with the Macrae Sisters, and formed the Horsenecks with Barry after the two met at a music festival in 2012. Barry’s banjo and guitar playing range from thrilling and high-octane to moody and captivating, and his versatility shines whether flatpicking, playing clawhammer, or driving three-finger banjo.  Barry has been a luminary in his home town of Liverpool’s music scene for over 20 years, playing lead guitar with cult heroes Tramp Attack, banjo with Liverpool’s popular bluegrass party band The Loose Moose Stringband, and with multiple groups in the UK’s bluegrass and old time scene. Both songwriters bring together their background in traditional music and modern influences across many genres to create a catalog of songs that speak to their place in the evolving story of traditional music. Together, they create a distinctive sound, their deft musicianship, creative instincts and powerful harmony singing front and center, earning them a place among the leading interpreters of Old Time music today.

events.description:
Join us on November 21st, 2026, from 10:30 am until 12:00 pm for a FREE event: Smokey Bear & His Wildlife Friends!

Back by popular demand, we will present a program with live birds of prey! First, we will meet these amazing animals and learn how we can all protect these regal birds by being fire-safe in the forest. Then, the big man himself, Smokey Bear, will visit the Museum and will pose for pictures with visitors. Finally, kids can complete a forest-themed craft project. It’s going to be a wild time at the Museum, so don’t miss out!

All activities are FREE and will be indoors. Free admission to the Museum will also be offered to all who attend this special event. Reservations are not required for this event.

A special thank you to the New York Wildlife Rescue Center, Inc. for presenting Wildlife Alive!

The FASNY (The Firefighters Association of the State of New York) Museum of Firefighting is located at 117 Harry Howard Avenue, Hudson, NY, 12534, and is open Wednesday through Sunday from 10:00 am until 4:30 pm.

events.title: Basilica Farm & Flea Holiday Market
events.description:
BASILICA FARM & FLEA: Born Thanksgiving Weekend 2013 as the Anti-Black Friday big sister goddess, Basilica Farm & Flea is part timeless flea market, part farmer’s market, part 21st century craft and design fair. Each market features a wide ranging group of regional vendors selling their handmade & collected wares alongside locally-sourced, farm-fresh foods. With over 10,000 square feet of raw space that has been historically and sustainably renovated, Basilica Farm & Flea is one of the only markets of this scale in the region, and is an integral part of Basilica Hudson’s arts and cultural programs.

We are thrilled to host over 140 regional independent businesses made up of artists, artisans, collectors, farmers, chefs, herbalists, publishers , designers & organizations joining us for Basilica Farm & Flea Holiday Market for 2026! With Black Friday Weekend known for big box corporate mass consumerism, we are proud to offer an alternative, where high quality, local and sustainably sourced is the norm. Alongside curated shopping we have many community workshops and craft activities on offer, alongside an abundance of tasty farm fresh food & drink to try! This year will be our biggest Farm & Flea yet, as we are adding an outdoor dining courtyard, expanded marketplace into the Back Gallery, and Germantown based Gatherwild will be popping up a *Tent Village* with their heated canvas tents hosting *farm camp* activities like custom chainstitching on textiles & charm bracelet making. This is a full Basilica Hudson campus take over & we couldn’t be more excited:)

events.title: LIVE: James Maddock / Ben Higginbotham
events.description:
SATURDAY, DECEMBER 12 • JAMES MADDOCK + BEN HIGGINBOTHAM (aka CYPRESS)
Some nights at the Park are about discovering an artist you’ve never heard before. And some nights are about finally getting an artist into the room who has been quietly influencing the Folk & Americana world for years.
James Maddock is one of those songwriters.
With a voice that Relix Magazine describes as “lived-in” and “craggy,” Maddock has built a remarkable catalog of songs that are deeply human, beautifully crafted, and meant to be heard live.
From his days fronting Wood to his celebrated solo records Sunrise on Avenue C, Wake Up and Dream, Another Life and The Green, Maddock has established himself as one of the most respected singer-songwriters working today. Along the way, he’s shared stages and collaborated with artists including Bruce Springsteen, Willie Nile, Counting Crows, The Waterboys and more.
And now, he’s bringing that songwriting and that unmistakable voice to the Park.
Opening the evening is Ben Higginbotham (aka Cypress), a Queens-based singer-songwriter originally from Dallas, TX. Ben’s melodic songwriting sits somewhere between the intimacy of Ray LaMontagne and Phoebe Bridgers and the timeless storytelling of Bonnie Raitt, Bruce Springsteen and Townes Van Zandt. Cypress’s debut EP A Fine Line has already found a wide audience, with “Still Blue” surpassing 2.3 million Spotify streams.
Two exceptional songwriters.
One intimate room.

events.title: SAMMY RAE + THE FRIENDS
events.description: For as much as Sammy Rae & The Friends may be a band, this collective of dreamers and artists consider themselves a family first. That all-for-one and one-for-all camaraderie ignites their unforgettable and can’t-miss live shows, which serve as a catharsis for both the musicians and their fervent audience. Fronted by singer/songwriter Sammy Rae and honed through years of touring, the group is capable of flourishing in any spotlight thanks to its signature blend of palpable chemistry, deft virtuosity, and vocal fireworks.
